decontamination_notes: Real feature from eslint/eslint PR #21175, merged 2026-08-11, after the training cutoffs of the models this suite targets; re-check upstream_merged against any newer model's cutoff before reusing. no-unmodified-loop-condition grouped ternary loop conditions (any modified reference silenced the whole condition); the feature adds a checkConditionalExpressions option (schema object with additionalProperties: false, defaultOptions [{checkConditionalExpressions: false}]) that stops ConditionalExpression from grouping so each reference must itself be modified, plus the lib/types/rules.d.ts update (multi_file). Repo sliced at the PR base commit (d3266fb2) to lib/ + conf/ + messages/ + package.json + LICENSE; deps come from the per-task image vulcanbench/sandbox:eslint-21175 (same NODE_PATH pattern as eslint-21163, built with the task repo as docker context). Hidden tests drive the rule through the public RuleTester API with node --test: 3 fail_to_pass, each verified failing at base (the base schema [] rejects any options object) and passing after the gold patch — option accepted with explicit false, option flagging an unmodified ternary operand (error COUNT only), and fully-modified ternaries staying valid under the option; 4 pass_to_pass guards pin option-less ternary grouping, plain unmodified-condition reporting, modified-condition validity, and unknown-option rejection (which holds at base and after). No message-text assertions.
